panel_f_version_note: latest all-event timing-plus-3D-direction reclustering: 28 axis-pair fits, 20 collinear pairs with abs(cosine)>=0.5 and a constructible shared axis, 18 with supported 2D geometry entering Fig2F, and 15/18 negative shared-field correlations. Upper and lower diamonds are strictly aligned because both encode the same observed raw cohort median r; the lower density is the matching raw-r full-contact-shuffle cohort-median null. Significance display separates negative prevalence (**) from the spatial-null permutation (***), with exact P values retained only in metadata/README.
